de.my_domain.abalone.gui

Class DesignUtil

  • java.lang.Object
    • de.my_domain.abalone.gui.DesignUtil

  • public final class DesignUtil
extends java.lang.Object
    The final DesignUtil Class. The DesignUtil final class is a utility class which offers constants and default values and colors, as well as a convert method for Color objects to be converted into Color objects, for the AbaloneGUI.

    • Method Detail

      • abaloneToAwt

        public static java.awt.Color abaloneToAwt(Color color)
        The abaloneToAwt method is a static method which transforms the three possible Color Objects, which are used in the Abalone Game, into Color, which are used in AWT to represent the color of BallPanels.
        Parameters:
        color - is an object of the type Color
        Returns:
        The colors BLACK_SLOT if color is BLACK, WHITE_SLOT if color is WHITE, EMPTY_SLOT if color is EMPTY, are returned.
